title: Cost of owning a home: More than a third of homeowners paid $3,000+ in surprise repairs
summary: With 36% of homeowners facing surprise repair bills over $3,000 last year, being prepared is key. We have tips for managing unexpected home maintenance costs.
body_markdown:
When it comes to the cost of homeownership, the conversation usually stops at the costs you plan for, like the down payment and the monthly mortgage. The costs that catch people off guard rarely make it into the budget, even though they’re nearly universal.


Only 8% of homeowners avoided surprise repair costs entirely last year, according to our[2026 Housepower Report](https://www.hippo.com/blog/housepower-report-2026) . For the majority who experienced unexpected home repairs, the bill ran past $1,000.


To help you plan for these unexpected repair costs, we've broken down where that money typically goes, how those costs add to financial stress, and which fixes are worth handling yourself.
